nodes.title: Removal of the Attributes tab's modules and their dedicated tests
nodes.summary: The tab component, its data hook and the three test files written solely for them are deleted from the tree, with every shared module they imported left standing and the type-check clean.

nodes.title: Unwire the Attributes tab from Case Detail's tab strip

nodes.title: Versions panel discloses a current version that does not read back as a case
nodes.summary: The Versions panel on Case Detail now reads the case's highest-numbered version and states, distinctly from a load failure and from a case holding no version, when that version does not read back as a case.

nodes.title: Proof that the Attributes tab's dead modules and their dedicated tests are gone, tree-wide
nodes.summary: Confirms the five deleted files are absent and that no file anywhere under frontend/app/src still names either the tab component's identifier or the hook's own identifier.

nodes.title: Proof for unwiring the Attributes tab from Case Detail's tab strip
nodes.summary: Tests establishing that Case Detail's tab strip now offers exactly Versions and Hypotheses, that case-detail-screen.tsx imports nothing from routes/case-attributes-tab, and that no spec anywhere in the tree still asserts an Attributes tab on Case Detail.

nodes.title: Versions panel discloses a current version that does not read back as a case
nodes.summary: Tests the new useCaseCurrentVersionValidity hook and its wiring into CaseDetailScreen's Versions panel against all nine criteria, and extends four pre-existing case-detail-screen specs' fetch stubs so the new per-version GET this task introduces succeeds instead of going unhandled.

nodes.title: Review of Case Detail's Attributes tab withdrawal
nodes.summary: What four passes found over the three tasks of epic/case-detail-attributes-tab: coverage over their 31 combined criteria, specification conformance staged over every trace binding, the project's own reading rules, and a clean captured run.
unproven: Every Case Detail spec other than the one asserting the Attributes tab passes without being edited.
Selecting the Versions tab on Case Detail mounts the same version-listing panel it mounted before this task.
The Versions panel still lists every version the case currently holds with its version number and the actions it offered before this task, where the case's versions were read.
The frontend suite passes with no spec edited to accommodate the deleted files.
The frontend type-check reports no unresolved module reference.

While that statement is rendered, the Versions panel presents no title, when_to_use, subject, fallback, consolidation_register, state or manifest of that version, nor any fact derived from them, as the content the case currently stands at.
case-detail-screen.tsx renders no tab content with the value "attributes".
frontend/app/src/hooks/use-case-versions.ts is unchanged by this task's delivery.
frontend/app/src/hooks/use-edit-draft-version-form.ts, errorStateKind included, is unchanged by this task's delivery.
frontend/app/src/routes/case-hypotheses-tab.test-support.ts is present in the tree and unchanged by this task's delivery.
frontend/app/src/services/case-version-record.ts is unchanged by this task's delivery.
